name: permitsnag-lookup
description: Backcountry permit and campground answers for the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia, with opening alerts on your PermitSnag account.

interface.longDescription:
PermitSnag answers permit and campground questions for backcountry trips in the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia.

Ask how to get a permit and you get how it is issued (lottery, reservation or in person), the season, the dates the agency has published, any closures, and the official booking page. Ask about specific dates and you get what PermitSnag's checks last recorded, with the time of the check. A date that has not been checked comes back as unknown, never as sold out.

It covers wilderness, backpacking, climbing, river and canoe permits and the New Zealand Great Walks, in national, state and provincial parks, plus campgrounds on Recreation.gov, state and provincial park systems, and the national park booking sites of Canada, New Zealand and Australia.

Sign in to PermitSnag to set up an opening alert, see your alerts or turn one off. Searching and reading need no account.

It does not book a permit or campsite, enter a lottery, or take payment. It reads stored checks and does not call a booking site when you ask.
defaultPrompt: Do I need a permit to hike the West Coast Trail in Canada?
Is the Milford Track booked online, and what has been open in January?
Find campgrounds near Big Sur and show how each is booked.

positive.prompt: What are the rules for Glacier National Park Wilderness permits?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the permit, says how it is issued and that it is booked online, gives the group size limit and any season or closure window, and links the official Recreation.gov page and the PermitSnag page. Every date is from an agency source.

positive.prompt: Check whether High Sierra Trail has permits available next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Turns next month into dates and says which. Reports either an opening with the time it was checked, or that there is no recent check of those dates. Never says sold out and never says available now. Links the agency page.

positive.description: A permit outside the US (New Zealand)
positive.prompt: Is the Milford Track booked online, and what has PermitSnag seen for January 10 to 14?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the Milford Track is booked online with cancellation openings PermitSnag tracks, links the New Zealand permit page and the official DOC page, and reports what was recorded for those dates with the time of the check, or that there is no recent check.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Upper Pines Campground and whether sites are open the first weekend of next month.
positive.expected_behavior: Says it is booked on Recreation.gov, that our checks count individual sites, and either what was recorded with the time or that there is no recent check.

positive.prompt: Get me into Grand Canyon Rim-to-Rim.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the official booking link and says plainly that PermitSnag only gives the link and does not book, pay or enter a lottery.

positive.description: Set up, list and turn off an alert (signed in with the reviewer account)
positive.prompt: Set up a PermitSnag alert for Upper Pines Campground for 2 nights, checking in any day from June 10 to June 12 next year. Then list my alerts, then turn that alert off.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the reviewer to sign in to PermitSnag the first time. Then confirms the alert is set up, or, if the account needs a plan, says so and names the plans page. Lists the account's alerts, then turns the alert off and says it is off. It never shows a payment or checkout link.

negative.description: Hotel (P-227). Not a permit or campground: the plugin is not called, and ChatGPT answers with its own tools or says it cannot book hotels.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Paris for next weekend.

negative.description: Flight (P-232). Not a permit or campground: the plugin is not called.
negative.prompt: Find a flight to Denver on Friday.

negative.description: A campsite outside the four countries. PermitSnag covers the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia and does not book: the plugin is not called, or if called it returns no match and says so.
negative.prompt: Book a campsite in Picos de Europa National Park in Spain.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and links to no checkout. Signed-in people can set up opening alerts in their own PermitSnag account; when an alert needs a paid plan, the answer names the plans page on permitsnag.com.

publication.release_notes: Covers the US, Canada, New Zealand and Australia. Adds opening alerts on your own PermitSnag account, with sign-in.
